#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys


def main():
    n = int(sys.argv[1])

    lines = []

    stretch_depth = n + 1
    stretch_check = (1 << (stretch_depth + 1)) - 1
    lines.append(f"stretch tree of depth {stretch_depth}\t check: {stretch_check}")

    for depth in range(4, n + 1, 2):
        tree_count = 1 << (n - depth + 4)
        node_count = (1 << (depth + 1)) - 1
        check = tree_count * node_count
        lines.append(f"{tree_count}\t trees of depth {depth}\t check: {check}")

    long_lived_check = (1 << (n + 1)) - 1
    lines.append(f"long lived tree of depth {n}\t check: {long_lived_check}")

    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
